BALDURS_ENEMYS-INTERACT.title: Interact
BALDURS_ENEMYS-INTERACT.description:
Interact with an enemy marked Interactable. The effect depends on the target:
Oil Barrel -> an Explosive Ampoule; Nightsong -> interact twice for Dame Aylin; Hostage -> Looming Fruit + Lees Waffle; Giantslayer -> its own relic.
Owlbear -> roll 1d20: on 14+ you win the combat outright (retry on failure). Owlbear Cub -> it dies, then roll 1d20: on 13+ gain Pael's Legion.
End your turn.
